newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banco Real seeks approval for bank in Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Banco Real seeks approval for bank in Argentina.

text.p: Brazilian private retail bank Banco Real is waiting for an approval by Argentine authorities to transform its branch in Argentina into a subsidiary, the bank's president said.

Paulo Guilherme Monteiro Lobato Ribeiro said the bank, which will be called Banco Real de Argentina S.A. and fully owned by Banco Real, will remain focusing on corporate banking and foreign trade operations, moving slowly to the retail sector.
"Banco Real is essentially a retail bank. Our expertise in Latin America is retail and we will take advantage of it," he said.

Ribeiro emphasized, however, that the transformation of Real's branch in Argentina into a subsidiary does not mean a change in the bank's strategy in the region. "It does not imply a strategic change or more or less investment. As a bank, some procedures may be easier in the future," he said.
He said Real has been interested in Argentina due to its links with Brazil via the Mercosur customs union.

He also said Real had requested approval by Brazil's Central Bank to transform the branch more than a year ago and in December last year, after Brazil's green light, it asked for approval by the Argentine authorities.
